data.body: Closure checkpoint: independent 32-row review PASS is durable with receipt SHA-256 ee721825a1398e4abbc95710ca9090a841f7ee4010cdd107e6b4d9b5055b2183. The reconciled seven-criterion plan passed and was signed at exact merged SHA 7882049ed97a669e98d0cbb1dd5e8662e5b01630 with zero blocking findings. Its minor P6 compound-criterion advisory is deferred because every clause already has explicit receipt/mechanical evidence and another wording-only edit would invalidate the fresh certificate without changing completion truth. The subsequent verify-completion attempt was not admitted: GATE_CONGESTED, both of 2 host gate slots occupied. No completion verdict or signature was produced. Per the no-retry/no-force rule, this ticket remains in_progress. Resume only after gate capacity is available: run verify-completion halfround-scowlful-polyp --ref 7882049ed97a669e98d0cbb1dd5e8662e5b01630 once; on signed PASS, transition in_progress to closed against the same ref.
